about: Outside Brutus's pen in the Lumbridge cow field, with iron melee gear, 30 combat and lobsters.
notes: Brutus step 1. South of the pen's gate (Brutus.OUTSIDE): Release goes into a field of the player's own, the gate out (Leave or Quick-escape) back here. The loadout is ours, not a live one (the Wiki's Strategies page lists free-to-play gear from steel up; iron is what the other scenarios already carry).
